problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate its fleet of 10 specialized transport vehicles to deliver 10 distinct categories of cargo, each requiring processing through 10 sequential handling stages.  
The revenue generated per ton for each cargo category is listed below:  
* Cargo Alpha yields 14.151 per ton  
* Cargo Beta yields 11.037 per ton  
* Cargo Gamma yields 17.316 per ton  
* Cargo Delta yields 13.598 per ton  
* Cargo Epsilon yields 7.676 per ton  
* Cargo Zeta yields 14.966 per ton  
* Cargo Eta yields 12.132 per ton  
* Cargo Theta yields 15.481 per ton  
* Cargo Iota yields 8.09 per ton  
* Cargo Kappa yields 9.352 per ton  

The handling duration per ton for each stage is provided as follows:  
* For Cargo Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 0.748 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.723, Stage 3 consumes 1.466, Stage 4 consumes 0.832, Stage 5 consumes 1.398, Stage 6 consumes 0.228, Stage 7 consumes 0.245, Stage 8 consumes 1.043, Stage 9 consumes 1.85, Stage 10 consumes 0.285

* For Cargo Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.74, Stage 2 consumes 0.247, Stage 3 consumes 0.841, Stage 4 consumes 1.692, Stage 5 consumes 0.507, Stage 6 consumes 0.542, Stage 7 consumes 0.295, Stage 8 consumes 0.253, Stage 9 consumes 1.796, Stage 10 consumes 1.587  
* For Cargo Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.179, Stage 2 consumes 1.721, Stage 3 consumes 0.473, Stage 4 consumes 1.973, Stage 5 consumes 1.5, Stage 6 consumes 1.674, Stage 7 consumes 0.664, Stage 8 consumes 0.234, Stage 9 consumes 1.302, Stage 10 consumes 1.55  
* For Cargo Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.87, Stage 2 consumes 0.468, Stage 3 consumes 0.603, Stage 4 consumes 1.304, Stage 5 consumes 1.667, Stage 6 consumes 0.735, Stage 7 consumes 0.904, Stage 8 consumes 1.454, Stage 9 consumes 0.34, Stage 10 consumes 1.058  
* For Cargo Eta, Stage 1 consumes 0.682, Stage 2 consumes 0.26, Stage 3 consumes 0.858, Stage 4 consumes 0.736, Stage 5 consumes 1.81, Stage 6 consumes 1.218, Stage 7 consumes 0.62, Stage 8 consumes 0.753, Stage 9 consumes 1.144, Stage 10 consumes 1.979  
* For Cargo Theta, Stage 1 consumes 0.693, Stage 2 consumes 0.88, Stage 3 consumes 0.402, Stage 4 consumes 0.339, Stage 5 consumes 0.555, Stage 6 consumes 1.369, Stage 7 consumes 1.432, Stage 8 consumes 1.682, Stage 9 consumes 1.688, Stage 10 consumes 0.694  
* For Cargo Iota, Stage 1 consumes 0.869, Stage 2 consumes 1.901, Stage 3 consumes 1.144, Stage 4 consumes 1.363, Stage 5 consumes 1.464, Stage 6 consumes 1.861, Stage 7 consumes 0.938, Stage 8 consumes 1.595, Stage 9 consumes 1.0, Stage 10 consumes 0.816  
* For Cargo Kappa, Stage 1 consumes 1.527, Stage 2 consumes 1.305, Stage 3 consumes 0.758, Stage 4 consumes 1.258, Stage 5 consumes 0.39, Stage 6 consumes 1.847, Stage 7 consumes 0.257, Stage 8 consumes 0.328, Stage 9 consumes 1.453, Stage 10 consumes 1.613  

The cumulative handling time allocated to each stage cannot surpass its available operational capacity:  
* Stage 1’s total handling time is limited to 284.164 hours  
* Stage 2’s total handling time is limited to 253.581 hours  
* Stage 3’s total handling time is limited to 222.192 hours  
* Stage 4’s total handling time is limited to 254.103 hours  
* Stage 5’s total handling time is limited to 219.439 hours  
* Stage 6’s total handling time is limited to 280.753 hours  
* Stage 7’s total handling time is limited to 175.608 hours  
* Stage 8’s total handling time is limited to 223.112 hours  
* Stage 9’s total handling time is limited to 221.59 hours  
* Stage 10’s total handling time is limited to 331.729 hours  

Subject to the condition that the total processing duration for each respective stage must remain within its prescribed time allowance, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category so as to maximize the aggregate revenue.
